description: Browse and record evidence, track unknowns and record settled findings.

identity.goal: Complete the gather evidence use case of craft-anything using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the craft-anything upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `craftanything` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced craftanything_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `craftanything_core_evidence_show`, `craftanything_core_evidence_browse`, `craftanything_core_unknowns_show`, `craftanything_core_unknown_add`, `craftanything_core_finding_record`. Steps: (1) Record a finding against at least one evidence id. (2) Track each unknown and what would settle it. (3) Check a resolved unknown against its cited evidence. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace craftanything was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
